# Python dependency for the project-structure graph page (see docs/graphify.html),
# generated by `.github/workflows/docs_build.yml`.
#
# Deliberately separate from requirements-docs.txt. graphify pulls in roughly
# thirty packages (networkx, numpy, rapidfuzz and ~25 tree-sitter grammars)
# against the three the MkDocs build needs, and its generation step is non-fatal:
# a resolution failure here must degrade to a missing graph page, not abort the
# docs build. Sharing one requirements file would make it abort.
#
# Pinned exactly rather than loosely: graphify ships near-daily 0.9.x releases
# that routinely change node and edge shape, and bumps its AST cache schema on
# upgrade. Treat a version bump as a deliberate change with a rebuild to verify.
#
# The PyPI package is `graphifyy` with a double y -- upstream flags this
# explicitly. Plain `graphify` on PyPI is an unaffiliated project.
graphifyy==0.9.88
